lines: 2026 All-Star Game Set - NBA Topps NOW® - 26 Card Set - PR: 4967
(1) Parallel or Autograph Redemption per set!
26-card complete set - featuring the 25 selected 2026 NBA All-Stars PLUS (1) of the following cards guaranteed:
Redemption for autographed base card parallel /5 or lower

The NBA’s biggest stars head from the hardcourt to your collection with the official 2026 NBA Topps Now All-Star Game set! Included in this 26-card set are the 2026 NBA All-Star Game selections, featuring the 10 All-Star starters and 15 reserves, and one (1) of the following cards guaranteed: Exclusive All-Star Parallel, numbered base card parallel, redemption for autographed base card parallel.
